name: bloodlink-server
description: BloodLink - Online Blood Donation and Emergency Donor Management System Backend

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const opts = process.platform === 'linux' ? { binary: { version: '7.0.14' } } : {}; require('mongodb-memory-server').MongoMemoryServer.create(opts).then(s => s.stop()).catch(e => console.warn(e))"
